facts.text: The hotel is perched above the V&A Waterfront in Cape Town.
facts.excerpt: a luxury hotel in Cape Town perched above the V&A Waterfront

facts.text: The hotel is defined by pillowed-glass windows with panoramic views from Table Mountain to the Table Bay harbour.
facts.excerpt: is defined by its shimmering pillowed-glass windows which offer panoramic views stretching from Table Mountain to the Table Bay harbour

facts.text: The hotel occupies six floors above the Zeitz Museum of Contemporary Art Africa (MOCAA).
facts.excerpt: Our luxury accommodation occupies six floors above the Zeitz Museum of Contemporary Art Africa (MOCAA)

facts.text: The hotel and museum are in a historic grain silo building built in 1924; the hotel is in its grain elevator portion.
facts.excerpt: The hotel and the museum are located within the historic grain silo building that was built in 1924. The Silo Hotel is in the grain elevator portion of the grain silo building

facts.text: The exterior of the building was designed by Thomas Heatherwick of Heatherwick Studio.
facts.excerpt: The exterior of the building and the inside of the museum has been designed by Thomas Heatherwick, Founder and Principal of the London-based **Heatherwick Studio**.

facts.text: Guided tours of Zeitz MOCAA can be arranged with the hotel concierge.
facts.excerpt: guided tours of the museum can be arranged with the hotel concierge

facts.text: The hotel's art collection was selected by Royal Portfolio owner Liz Biden and features African contemporary artists.
facts.excerpt: Meticulously selected by the owner of The Royal Portfolio and avid art enthusiast, Liz Biden, The Silo Hotel’s art collection houses some of Africa’s most talented, emerging, and eminent contemporary artists.

facts.text: The hotel has a heated rooftop swimming pool.
facts.excerpt: Heated rooftop swimming pool

facts.text: The hotel has The Vault Private Art Gallery.
facts.excerpt: The Vault Private Art Gallery

facts.text: The Deluxe Superior Suites look out on the harbour and Table Mountain through geometric windows 18 feet tall.
facts.excerpt: Savour views of the harbour and Table Mountain through spectacular geometric windows standing 18 feet tall.

facts.text: The two-bedroom Royal Suites have views of Table Mountain, the Atlantic Ocean and Robben Island.
facts.excerpt: The scenic two-bedroom Royal Suites boast views of Table Mountain, the Atlantic Ocean, and Robben Island.

facts.text: The Penthouse is on the top floor.
facts.excerpt: Located on the top floor, The Penthouse is the jewel in The Royal Portfolio’s crown.

facts.text: The double-storey Duplex Suites each have a balcony and lounge.
facts.excerpt: These double-story suites each have a balcony and lounge

facts.text: The two-bedroom Family Duplex Suites have a smaller kids' room.
facts.excerpt: Our double-storey, two-bedroom Family Duplex Suites have a smaller kids’ room

facts.text: The Silo Rooftop is the highest point in the V&A Waterfront, with panoramic ocean and city views, serving cocktails and light meals.
facts.excerpt: As the highest point in the V&A Waterfront, The Silo Rooftop offers panoramic ocean and city views

facts.text: Royal Tea is served at The Granary Café.
facts.excerpt: The Granary Café is the ultimate destination to enjoy a leisurely lunch, an elegant dinner or experience our renowned Royal Tea.

facts.text: Dining at the hotel is by prior reservation only.
facts.excerpt: Dining at The Silo Hotel is available exclusively by prior reservation

facts.text: The Silo Spa is on the fourth floor and has five treatment rooms, two of which can be made into a couple's room.
facts.excerpt: The Silo Spa, located on the fourth floor of The Silo Hotel, has five treatment rooms, two of which can be made into a couple’s room.

facts.text: The spa has a fitness centre, sauna and a manicure and pedicure area, and therapists use products including Ling and Black Pearl.
facts.excerpt: The Silo Hotel Spa also has a double-treatment room, fitness centre, sauna and a dedicated manicure and pedicure area. Our expert therapists use top local and international products including Ling and Black Pearl.

facts.text: The spa is open to non-resident guests, subject to availability.
facts.excerpt: The Silo Hotel Spa is open to non-resident guests, subject to availability.

facts.text: The Zeitz MOCAA museum is located just below the hotel.
facts.excerpt: It is located just below The Silo Hotel.

facts.text: Hiking and biking tracks along the seaside and up mountain paths are a short distance from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Discover hiking and biking tracks along the seaside and up mountain paths, all just a short distance from The Silo Hotel.

facts.text: The Silo Hotel opened on 1 March 2017 after 3 years of construction.
facts.excerpt: The Silo Hotel opened on 1 March 2017 after 3 years of construction.

facts.text: Check-in is at 2pm and check-out is at 11am.
facts.excerpt: Check-in is at 2pm and check-out is at 11am.

facts.text: The hotel has secure underground parking.
facts.excerpt: Secure underground parking

facts.text: The Wisdom Room is a glass-fronted private dining room for up to 22 guests.
facts.excerpt: the exclusive, glass-fronted Wisdom Room can host up to 22 guests for next-level private dining experiences
